Case reference: 2014001088.CaseDesc: On September 13, 1973, the remains of an adult male were recovered from the Whirlpool of the Niagara River, in Niagara Falls. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 165lbs, however, this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His eye colour is believed to be brown. He was recovered without clothing.

Ring: Silver ring with a green stone on the third finger of his right hand
Watch: Cloth, Left wrist, had a red, yellow and blue watchstrap.

Case reference: 2014001985.CaseDesc: Odette Richard was last seen on February 25, 1990 at approximately 6:30 p.m., when she went for a walk from her home in Laval, Quebec. Odette has not been seen or heard from since.

Teeth: Other, Full, upper and lower dentures
Deformity: Right Foot, Bone bump, top of foot

Case reference: 2014002218.CaseDesc: On September 18, 1977, Arthur Roy was seen for the last time, at approximately 1400hrs, when he left his home on foot in North Bay, Ontario. Arthur was suffering from a mental illness and was believed to be senile due to old age.

Case reference: 2014003916.CaseDesc: Pierrette Bouffard was last seen on January 9, 1997, in Saint-Romuald, Quebec, as she was heading to her room in the home she was living in.

Case reference: 2018016431.CaseDesc: On March 22, 2018, Crystal Hackett was seen for the last time in Lloydminster, Alberta. During the time of her disappearance, Crystal may have been suffering from mental health issues.

Scar: Jaw, Thin white scar on the right side of jaw

Case reference: 2014006326.CaseDesc: Ronald Kay was reported missing to the Regina Police Service on November 26, 2013. He was last seen at the Saskatchewan Rough Riders Football game and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2012020660.CaseDesc: Hamza Alsharief has not been in contact with friends or family members since December 14, 2011. Originally from Saudi Arabia, he is a student at the University of Saskatchewan. Although there is no evidence of foul play, Hamza's family members have expressed their concern that it is unusual that he has had no contact with them.

Hair: Brown, Short, Short to medium length
Mark: Lower Lip, Small growth of facial hair

Case reference: 2014004946.CaseDesc: On April 21 2007, vehicle belonging to Richard Gallegos was found near the Niagara Falls, in Niagara Falls, Ontario. Richard has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014004230.CaseDesc: Raymond "Ray" Kohout, a nurse, husband and father of three from Salmon Arm, British Columbia has been missing since April 29, 2002. He was last seen at approximately 4:30 p.m. riding a blue mountain bike on the Trans-Canada Highway between Salmon Arm and Canoe. On September 11, 2002, his bike was recovered between Salmon Arm and Sicamous, British Columbia. Raymond has not been seen or heard from since.

Jewelry: ring on the left ring finger
Sweater: Blue, Sweatshirt with “Selkirk College” on the front

Case reference: 2014003988.CaseDesc: On February 16, 1989, Gordon Clark was last seen at his residence in Richmond, British Columbia.  He had an argument with his common law wife who left the residence and when she returned home, he was gone.  Gordon has not been heard from or seen by any family members or friends since.

Case reference: 2010001199.CaseDesc: Michael Hinsperger was in a canoe on Carson Lake, Barry's Bay, at 3:00 P.M. on May 13th 2010. The canoe was recovered but Michael has not been located.

Jacket: Black, Yellow lettering "Harley Davidson Owners club"

Case reference: 2013000109.CaseDesc: On October 25, 1996, Huguette Douville was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. Huguette walks with an irregular gait, specifically a hunchback posture and always carries grocery bags, and was known to regularly hitchhike.

Case reference: 2010003699.CaseDesc: On the evening of Friday, May 31 1974, seven-year-old Cheryl Hanson left her home on Bloomington Road in Aurora, Ontario, for a 10-minute walk to her cousin's house, which was also located on Bloomington Road. Unfortunately, Cheryl never arrived and there has been no trace of her or her belongings.

Coat: Paper bag with white pajamas with floral design

Case reference: 2014004730.CaseDesc: Geoffrey MacGibbon was last seen in Toronto, Ontario. In 1978, Geoffrey and his family relocated from Quebec to Toronto, Ontario. He has a history of mental health issues and has been in care in both Canada and the United States.

Scar: Front Of Neck, Tracheostomy scar on throat

Case reference: 2005001599.CaseDesc: Shawn Jones and Leslie Jones were last seen together between October 26- 28, 1993, at the Tim Hortons in Owen Sound, Ontario.  Shawn was seen on Berford Street in front of the Pacific Hotel and Leslie was seen on 9th East Street in front of the Tim Hortons.

Case reference: 2010003799.CaseDesc: On Wednesday August 16, 1972, at 9:40 pm, 14 year-old Ingrid Bauer left her residence in Kleinburg, now the city of Vaughan, enroute to meet her boyfriend at his North Woodbridge home. She was last seen hitchhiking southbound along the west side of Islington Avenue.  She never arrived at her boyfriend’s residence that night.  An extensive search based on information received from the public failed to locate Ingrid Bauer.

Case reference: 2014005036.CaseDesc: Cory Bannerman was seen for the last time when he left work on November 26, 2007, in Edmonton, Alberta. At the time of his disappearance, Cory was despondent.

Case reference: 2016030649.CaseDesc: Kean Luo was originally from Malaysia, but relocated to the United States to attend school and begin his career. He relocated to Winnipeg, Manitoba on March 2, 2016, for professional reasons. Concerns were raised by friends and family when Kean was not available to receive calls or messages for an extended period of time. However, on April 2, 2016, police spoke with Kean at a local hotel in Kenora, Ontario. He stated that he was not considering ending his own life, but was experiencing stress and missing his family. His vehicle was subsequently discovered parked on the shoulder of the highway on the Sergeant Thomas Cooper Bridge (Kenora). All mobile phone and banking activity has since ceased.

Case reference: 2016061831.CaseDesc: On September 1, 1980, a caucasian male, believed to be between the ages of 50 to 65 years old, was found at the bottom of the fourth floor stairway of the parking garage at 50 Cumberland Avenue in Yorkville, Toronto. He had trauma to his face and skull possibly due to a fall down the stairs. His appendix was present and he was circumcised.

Hair: Brown, Grey, Short, Beard of a couple of days
Teeth: Visible Missing, Many of his teeth were lost some time before death and some of the remaining teeth had cavities. He had no dental work.
Pants: Brown, Blue, Light brown, plaid, Levi's brand
Shirt: Yellow, Long sleeved sport shirt with "Stevenson 114" written on the inside of the collar
Shorts: Light Blue, Dark Blue, Checkered, size 30 from Sears

Case reference: 2017060465.CaseDesc: On September 24, 2017, Jesse Clint Galganov was seen for the last time when he took a flight to Peru from the Montréal-Pierre-Elliott Trudeau Airport in Montreal, Quebec. On September 28, 2017, Jesse contacted his mother to tell her that he was going to go hiking for a few days in the forest. Since this time, Jesse has not been seen nor has he contacted his family to provide them with his whereabouts which is contrary to his habits.

Shoes: Black, White, Running shoes with white soles

Case reference: 2014005313.CaseDesc: On September 24, 2007, Azelea Brown last spoke to her mother who was overseas.

Case reference: 2013000037.CaseDesc: On November 29, 2001, Henry Murillo Asprilla was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. On that day, he had a meeting with lawyers, which he attended with his ex-wife. After the meeting he drove his ex-wife home. Henry has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2023046914.CaseDesc:
On August 22, 2023, Jasmine Laboucan was seen for the last time in Grande Prairie, AB.

Jasmine has a medical condition and may be confused or disorientated.

Case reference: 2012020057.CaseDesc: Peter Halcrow was last seen on March 14, 1994 walking in the "Sawmill" area between 14:00hrs and 15:00hrs.  Peter has not been seen since.

Shoes: Leather, Green, White, Reebok with purple

Case reference: 2006028499.CaseDesc: On August 3, 1968, at approximately 4:30 p.m. Robert James Brown was last seen walking from the Nazarene Camp to his home in the Village of Wilfred, Ontario. The Nazarene Camp was a Christian camp near Pefferlaw, where Robert's mother worked as a volunteer. He never arrived home and was reported missing to the Georgina Township Police Service. There were reports that a person matching Robert's description was seen in the vicinity of Georgina Beach around the time that Robert was last seen. Numerous land and water searches failed to locate Robert.

Case reference: 2014001413.CaseDesc: On September 18, 1959, Captain Charles David Tillsley, Warrant Officer Tyrus Cobb, Sergeant Major James Mackey, and a fourth companion left Fort Churchill on a weekend fishing trip on the Churchill River in Manitoba. They were last seen loading their gear into a boat at the Churchill Dock at around 1 p.m. They were due back on September 20, but failed to return. Fort Churchill's military authorities commenced a search with the aid of helicopters and aircraft. On September 21, the two boats used by the men were located; both were undamaged and swamped. Numerous items belonging to the four men were found. Despite extensive land and water searches, the bodies were not found.

Case reference: 2017073542.CaseDesc: On November 4, 2016, an unidentified man was discovered in Lake Ontario in St. Catharines, Ontario. Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts he was of East Asian Ancestry.

Case reference: 2008004699.CaseDesc: Adave Francis was last seen at 6:00 p.m. on October 13, 1999, riding his bicycle on the farm property located at Poplar Sideroad in the Collingwood, Ontario area. Adave was a seasonal worker from Jamaica.

Case reference: 2013000068.CaseDesc: On October 27, 1994, Yvon Ringuet was reported missing from his home in the Rosemont-La Petite-Patrie district in Montreal, Quebec. Yvon would call or visit his mother everyday. All his personal belongings were found in his home and no one has seen or heard from him since.

Tattoo: Cross, right or left upper arm

Case reference: 2014001046.CaseDesc: On July 23, 1990, the body of this middle-aged man was found on Gore Avenue in Vancouver, British Columbia. He died of complications related to chronic alcohol dependence.

Hair: Blonde, Long dark blonde hair with greying beard
Jacket: Denim, Blue, Young Life Creator brand
Shoes: Grey, Nike Air brand, running shoes

Case reference: 2014005841.CaseDesc: Alfred Sassin has not been seen since he left his home in downtown Vancouver on July 9, 2012. Mr. Sassin's absence was reported to police by the resident caretakers on July 16, as they had not seen him for over a week, which was unusual for him.

Case reference: 2014001966.CaseDesc: On September 10, 1976, Edwin Lewitsky was seen for the last time in Wellandport, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, Edwin was driving a 1970 two-toned green Ford Galaxy.

Case reference: 2020011563.CaseDesc: On July 17, 1988, at approximately 12:00pm, Mosses Korman was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2016069642.CaseDesc: On April 21, 1995, the remains of a woman were discovered near Carbon, Alberta. The post-mortem interval is estimated to be between 10 and 15 years. The individual had dental restorations including stainless steel crowns.

Case reference: 2024004350.CaseDesc: Lijun Su was last seen by his family at approximately 6:30 am, on January 27,2024. On that day a surge of river water and ice occurred on the Saugeen River in the town of Saugeen Shores / Southampton, Ontario. It is believed that Lijun was fishing on the Saugeen river and was taken away with the ice and water surge.

Case reference: 2008008099.CaseDesc: Ronald Wallin was canoeing in the Upper Manitou Lake located south of Dryden, Ontario.  Ronald suffered from what appeared to be a seizure and fell into the water disappearing beneath the boat. The area was searched, but he wasn't found.

Case reference: 2009004999.CaseDesc: At the time of her disappearance, Dawn Carisse was a patient of the North Bay Psychiatric Hospital. She is generally very pleasant though suffers from short term memory loss due to cardiac arrest several years earlier.  Dawn always spoke of leaving the hospital and going to where she believed her family would be. Her family was in the Kirkland Lake area and then moved to Sudbury. She was aware of both, and her possible destinations were Kirkland Lake or Sudbury. She was last seen on Highway 11 North, in North Bay, Ontario.

Hair: Brown, Curly, Parted in centre, short bangs
Dress: Maroon, Pink, Long dress with faint white flowers, short sleeves and front buttons.
Luggage: May have had a dark duffle bag in her possession.

Case reference: 2016045557.CaseDesc: In January 2015, Warner Huckerby was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014001642.CaseDesc: In October 1983, Edna Smith was last seen at a camp with two other persons on East Trout Lake, located approximately 120 kilometres north of Prince Albert, Saskatchewan. A search operation successfully located the bodies of her two companions, but she herself remained unaccounted for. The boat that had been used by the three individuals was discovered capsized in the lake. It is suspected that all three individuals drowned.

Deformity: Mouth, Cleft Palate had been operated on

Case reference: 2026024883.CaseDesc: Maurice Auger was last seen on May 7, 2026, at around 8:00 am walking in the Mont-Tremblant (Saint-Jovite) area of Quebec. He may be wearing a grey canvas coat.

Case reference: 2014004580.CaseDesc: On the morning of July 23, 1991, a group of 8 individuals left Igloolik, Nunavut and headed to Hall Beach, Nunavut.  The group travelled using a 24 foot freighter canoe powered by a 30 hp outboard motor.  It was a stormy day with heavy rain and approximately 24 km north of Hall Beach, the canoe hit ice, filled with water and capsized.  Only one occupant made it back to shore.

Case reference: 2006023799.CaseDesc: On July 12, 1999, Jerzy Ryglewicz was last seen at a gas station in Merrickville, Ontario. He has not been seen or made contact with any friends or family since.

Case reference: 2014005882.CaseDesc: Romeo Cloutier was last seen September 13, 2012 in Moncton, New Brunswick. Romeo's vehicle was located in Sainte-Marie-de-Kent later on that same day. No other confirmed reports of Romeo's whereabouts have been made since.

Tattoo: Neck, Inscription "Keep your friends close, keep enemies closer"

Case reference: 2014006050.CaseDesc: On April 3, 2013, Patrice Mathieu was reported missing from his home in St-Joseph-de-Sorel, Quebec. Patrice was last seen the day before. Patrice does not own a car, however he does have a driver's licence and he usually travels on foot. Patrice is known to be quiet and is, by nature, anxious and withdrawn.

Coat: Black, Mid-thigh length with a hood
Jeans: Blue, With the bottom rolled up

Case reference: 2013000094.CaseDesc: Robert Beauchamp was last seen in Montreal, Quebec on June 22, 1993. Robert left his home with friends and was never seen again.

Case reference: 2014003025.CaseDesc: On March 5, 1989, Barbara McLaughlin was last seen leaving a friends residence in Roseville, Michigan in the USA.  A few days later Barbara's car was discovered on the Bluewater Bridge in Sarnia, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014005111.CaseDesc: Chad Eirikson was reported missing by his mother. He left Vancouver, Canada to tour Central America in December, 1999.  In January, 2000, he called home requesting money a few times and received wire transfers from his mother to continue his trip. He has not been heard from since January 9, 2000.

Case reference: 2016053812.CaseDesc: On September 11, 2016, at approximately 2:30 a.m., Van Pham was last seen in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2021055005.CaseDesc: On July 31, 2016, Karen Thompson was last seen at her daughter’s birthday party at Prince of Whales Park in Toronto, Ontario.

Tattoo: Left Shoulder, Elephant on left or right shoulder
Lower Back, 3 skulls on lower back

Case reference: 1992003440.CaseDesc: On May 13, 1984, Daniel Worobec was last seen in Lanigan, Saskatchewan, where a witness stated that he had told them he was waiting for a ride. Despite extensive searches and investigations, Daniel has not been located.

Boots: Brown, Cowboy boots with square toes
Hat: Blue, White, Baseball cap with writing on it

Case reference: 2025032880.CaseDesc: On April 29, 2025, a man was found unresponsive outside the Walmer TTC station building in Toronto, Ontario.

InfoSection: Plastic, Black, Plastic hair tie with duct tape

Case reference: 2014005577.CaseDesc: Ganiyu Adedeji Onabule was reported missing in Edmonton in June of 1975. He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2012020071.CaseDesc: Richard Tssessaze's last known place of residence was Brandon, Manitoba.  He had previously lived in Thompson and Lac Brochet.  He was last seen in the area around the St. Regis Hotel on Smith Street in downtown Winnipeg in late June 2009.  Richard has not been seen or heard from since that time, and his whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2008007599.CaseDesc: On September 10, 1978, Hugh Bain and three others participated in the Oshawa Clipper Race, which took place from Oshawa, Ontario to Olcott, New York and back to Oshawa. Hugh was assigned to operate the 24-foot vessel. A large wave hit the vessel, breaking over it. The movement of the vessel and the subsequent wave breaking over the boat caused him to fall into Lake Ontario.  He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2023023783.CaseDesc: Nathan Wise was last seen on May 12, 2023, in the area of Jane Street and Sheppard Avenue in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004087.CaseDesc: On October 31, 1996, James Withers was last seen at his family's residence.

Case reference: 2014004043.CaseDesc: On March 8, 2002, Eva Nakanjako, her husband Robert Mukwaya, and their son Emmanuel Mukwaya were last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Eva and Robert had not shown up for work for three weeks and had not paid their rent. During the time of their disappearance, their apartment was found partially emptied.

Case reference: 2006004699.CaseDesc: On July 13 1992, William Aman left the shore of Lake Ontario to go fishing.  His boat was later found with his ball cap 3.2 kilometers off of Pete's Point, Lake Ontario. William has not been located and is presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2008015999.CaseDesc: John Zuern went missing on June 14,1975, from the London Psychiatric Hospital in London, Ontario. He’s been diagnosed as schizophrenic and walks with a pronounced limp.  John’s brother reported seeing him in the Bloor and Spadina area of Toronto during the summer of 1980.  He was believed to have been living on the streets at the time.

Hair: Grey, Long, Unkempt; unkempt Beard, Moustache
Deformity: leg, walks with a pronounced limp

Case reference: 2014003978.CaseDesc: Ernest Robert Pfaff left home at approximately 8pm on December 31, 1973 to purchase a loaf of bread. He was driving a 1972 Ford Maverick, light blue in colour, with red pin stripes on the sides.

Coat: Grey, Three quarter length pile coat

Case reference: 2010000299.CaseDesc: On September 3, 2009, Douglas Chong contacted his sister to inform her that he had attended the Toronto Western Hospital due to feeling unwell. He stated that he had been suffering from dehydration and was referred to Seaton House for recuperation. He allegedly stayed there for a period of three days, after which he was in a better state and then released. This communication represents the last known contact with Douglas. He has not returned to his last known address in Toronto, and neither hospital has any record of him attending on or around September 3, 2009. There has been no use of his health or bank cards since that date.

Case reference: 2014003070.CaseDesc: On February 20, 1996, Yolande Trudeau Laberge was seen for the last time near the Larocque Bridge in Salaberry-de-Valleyfield, Quebec. Yolande has not been seen or heard from since.

Scar: Right Arm, Under arm, approximately 1 inch

Case reference: 2024001138.CaseDesc: Michael Walker left his friend's home in Norland, Ontario, following a weekend party on November 5, 2023. He was thought to be returning to his father's home, which is located 15 minutes east of the small hamlet of Kinmount, Ontario. On November 6, 2023, Michael's father discovered Michael's vehicle parked in his driveway, open and without keys. Michael has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2009002399.CaseDesc: On Friday, April 21 1972, Francis Harris went to a medical appointment with her husband in Peterborough. On the way home to Apsley, they stopped in Lakefield and she may have gone to the post office and the bank. They arrived home around 11:00 a.m. and ate lunch. Her husband went to work from approximately 1:00 p.m. to 5:05 p.m.  When their son returned home from school at about 3:40 p.m., Francis was not home.  She has not been seen or heard from since.

Hair: Grey, White, Short, Wavy, may have been dyed black
Ring: White gold engagement and wedding ring

Case reference: 2010003499.CaseDesc:
On March 21, 2010 Chung Law left work on Dundas St, London ON. He told his employer that he was experiencing some stress and would be taking a couple of days off. Chung spoke to his wife, who lives in Vaughan, ON, and told her he was coming home for a visit. He spoke to his employer the next day, saying he was in Toronto and that he did not want to return to work in London. Chung never made it home. Investigation has revealed that he may have travelled to Toronto by bus. 

In April, 2011 a right foot contained within a black boot was located in the river flats of the Thames River in Elgin County. The area was searched and no further remains were found. DNA confirmed that the foot was that of Chung.

Scar: Left Thigh, Surgery scar on upper left thigh

Case reference: 2006000399.CaseDesc: On August 19, 1988, the body of a Caucasian male was recovered from the Niagara River. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 132lbs; however, this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.

Hair: Auburn, Bald, Wavy, Balding in front, sideburns and unshaven with several days growth
Teeth: Many amalgam fillings, 1 composite resin restoration. Missing multiple upper and lower posterior teeth prior to death.
Belt: Leather, Brown, Size 34, with gold buckle & "Genuine Olde English Leather" written on the inner portion
Jeans: Blue, "Renée de France" Brand, size 34" waist and 34" inseam
Money: Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Canadian coins $2.26, one American dime
Fractured/Broken Bones: Healed fracture, noticeable bump on the middle of his right collarbone.

Case reference: 2025001081.CaseDesc: Thomas Hatcher was reported missing on January 7, 2025 from Durante's Trailer Park in Sioux Lookout, Ontario. The last record of him is from CCTV footage, in which he was observed walking eastwards in the direction of a wooded area on the morning of the 7th. Extensive searches were conducted, and his abandoned backpack was found to contain his birth certificate and other personal belongings. At that time, Thomas was feeling despondent.

Hat: Grey, Red, Grey toque with a red stripe

Case reference: 2018063467.CaseDesc: On December 12, 1995, at approximately 2:00 am, Ahmad Kharashfeh was last seen in Toronto, Ontario.

Jacket: Leather, Black, Short jacket with 2 red lines in the front

Case reference: 2012020137.CaseDesc: On Friday September 27, 1963, Diane Carrier left home and went to the neighbourhood park in the Old Quebec district of Quebec City, Quebec, to advise her brother to return home for dinner. Diane's brother returned home alone and Diane has never been seen since.

Case reference: 2014047277.CaseDesc: On December 16, 2014, at approximately 10:30 a.m., Abdool Kisson was last seen leaving his ex-girlfriend’s house in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2016008425.CaseDesc: Colleen Sylvia Smith was last seen at home, on February 9, 2016, by her ex-boyfriend/landlord.

Case reference: 2006003399.CaseDesc: On November 2, 2001, this male, was found in a sewer at 470 Lansdowne Avenue in Toronto. His ancestry is Caucasian, possibly Egyptian or mixed African/Caucasian. He had previous surgery of his left forearm, which had involved the implant of surgical plates. The numbers visible on the surgical plates could not be traced to a specific individual, however, it was determined that the lot was released some time after May 25, 1994. A MacDonald’s name tag with the name "Raymond" was found in the sewer, which may or may not be related to this individual.

Teeth: Visible Missing, Teeth were stained, which suggests he may have been a smoker,  his upper central incisors were also missing
Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Hip, recent fracture of left hip

Case reference: 2021000139.CaseDesc: On January 1st, 2021, Zachery Lefave was last seen around 12:30 a.m., talking on a cellular phone while walking on Highway # 334 in the Plymouth region of Yarmouth County, Nova Scotia. Zachery had left a New Year’s Eve party that was being held in the area.

Case reference: 2012020013.CaseDesc: Angeline Pete was last seen on May 26, 2011 leaving her residence in North Vancouver, BC.  Miss Pete's disappearance is suspicious and foul play cannot be excluded.

Hair: Brown, Long, Dyed, Often dyes it

Case reference: 2014001445.CaseDesc: On July 13, 1992, Howard Scott was last seen in Calgary, Alberta. Howard was travelling in his red 1985 Ford LTD Station Wagon from Calgary and was destined to return to Richmond, British Columbia. On August 15, 1992, Howard’s abandoned vehicle was located in a heavily wooded logging road near Moyie, British Columbia.  Howard has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2012020125.CaseDesc: Serge Crevier was last seen on July 17, 2006, around 1:30 p.m. at his residence in Gatineau, Quebec. The car that Serge was using, a grey Oldsmobile Alero 2002, was found on September 10, 2006 in Thorne, in the Outaouais region of Quebec.

Case reference: 2015059337.CaseDesc: On July 26, 2015, at approximately 10:30 p.m., Van Huong was last seen on vacation in Vietnam. The next morning, Van’s family noticed he had left the hotel room and had not returned.

Case reference: 2019052051.CaseDesc: On September 10, 2019, at approximately 4:00 am, Brandon Pollock was seen for the last time at his family residence in Hamilton, Ontario. That same morning, three men on a boat observed a man swimming in the area of the Lift Bridge in Lake Ontario. The men approached the swimmer, who was later identified as Brandon Pollock, to confirm his wellbeing. Brandon had told them that he was okay and advised them to pass by.

Mark: Right Side Of Neck, A brown birthmark on the right side of the neck, below the ear

Case reference: 2026000991.CaseDesc: On 2 August 2025, Nelson Boudreau and Gregory Landry set sail from Havre-Saint-Pierre, in Quebec, aboard a 24-foot Dorval boat, with the aim of fishing east of Havre-Saint-Pierre. The subsequent investigation revealed that debris from the boat had been found in the area between La Romaine and Chevery.

Tattoo: Back Of Neck, Tiger and Foliage

Case reference: 2015020929.CaseDesc: On April 27, 2015, Andrzej Popek was last seen at the Crawford Lake Conservation Area in Milton, Ontario.  Andrzej's abandoned vehicle was located the following day in the Conservation's parking lot.

Case reference: 2014002126.CaseDesc: On March 18, 1997, Mark Bird was seen for the last time when he left his home in Welland, Ontario. His abandoned vehicle was later found in Niagara Falls. At the time of his disappearance, Mark was despondent and he has not been seen or heard from since.

Jacket: Black, Hooded, San Francisco 49's football team

Case reference: 2009004899.CaseDesc: Sacha Latulippe left Montreal Airport for Mexico city on October 15, 2009. He advised his family he was leaving for business. Investigation revealed he had 2 wives in different towns and was leading a “double life”. He left with his business partner Eric Marcel on this same flight. Eric is also missing.

Hair: Blonde, Brush Cut, Spikey/gelled, natural brown; Sideburns

Case reference: 2018046096.CaseDesc: On August 14, 2018, Victor Falk was seen for the last time after being dropped off at his residence in Rosthern, Saskatchewan. At the time of his disappearance, Victor suffered from Alzheimer's disease.

Case reference: 2012020109.CaseDesc: David Fortin was last seen while waiting for the school bus on the morning of February 10, 2009, in Alma, Québec. He was to take the school bus at approximately 7:50 am to get to the Camille Lavoie High School in Alma. However, he never got onto the bus and did not report to school. According to his family, David was a victim of bullying and intimidation at school for several years.

Case reference: 2025005582.CaseDesc: Liam Toman was last seen on February 2, 2025 at 3:17 A.M. in the village of Mont-Tremblant, Quebec.  Liam spent the evening at the local bar, Le P'tit Caribou with a group of friends and was seen leaving on foot towards the Tour des Voyageurs 2 hotel (Ch du Curé Deslauriers).  Liam is originally from Ontario and investigators confirmed that the last pinged location of his cell phone was in the area surrounding the Mont-Tremblant station.  Liam had been drinking that night and has not been seen or heard since, which is contrary to his habits

Boots: Brown, Black, Work boots with black toe

Case reference: 2014001545.CaseDesc: On the morning of August 6, 1979, Timothy Papik and his daughter Diane left Rankin Inlet, Nunavut heading towards Whale Cove, Nunavut in a canoe. Timothy and Diane never reached their destination and they have not been seen since.

Tattoo: Left Forearm, Knife with snake, flower

Case reference: 2014001333.CaseDesc: On May 18, 1975, members of the Canadian Armed Forces located the personal belongings of William Bereziuk washed up on an island in the Athabasca River 50 km north of Fort McMurray, Alberta. In October 1974, William departed Edmonton with the objective of embarking on a canoe trip along the Athabasca River. He informed his family that he had plans to spend the winter of 1974 in the Birch Mountain area of Alberta and would return to Edmonton in August of 1975.

Jewelry: Metal, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Crucifix or scapular
Scar: Right Large Toe, Immersion foot (Trench Foot)

Case reference: 2015059939.CaseDesc: On October 20, 1973, the remains of a male were recovered from the water near the Fleet Street Pumping Station, Ottawa. It is estimated that he had been in the water between 2 and 3 months.

Case reference: 2022059675.CaseDesc: Rebecca Fudge-Schnarr was last seen on November 24, 2022, at approximately 10:00 a.m., at her family's residence on Moffat Road in Iroquois Falls, Ontario.

Case reference: 2012020049.CaseDesc: William Krowchuk was last seen leaving his residence in Saskatoon, SK, around 10:00 p.m. on July 9, 1998. The vehicle he was driving at the time of his disappearance was located on July 14, 1998, in the downtown area of Saskatoon.

Deformity: Left Large Toe, No toe nail

Case reference: 2024001594.CaseDesc: Alex Marko was seen for the last time on December 5, 2023 in Winnipeg, Manitoba. He is known for using housing resources for the homeless.

Case reference: 2016000962.CaseDesc: On January 5, 2016, Felix Claveau was last seen when he jumped off the Viau Bridge into the Rivière-des-Prairies in Laval, Quebec. Felix hasn’t been seen since.

Case reference: 2023039179.CaseDesc: Denis Taylor was last seen on July 22, 2023 at the Bulpit Lake Family Camp, located on Stringer Road in Carlow Mayo Township, East of Bancroft, Ontario. Denis planned to meet everyone in the common beach area after a brief nap in his cabin, which was located a distance away, but he never arrived. Denis may have woken up disoriented in the new cabin and taken the wrong path to the communal area.

Case reference: 2013000092.CaseDesc: Jacques Boulanger was last seen on September 1, 1989 in Montreal, Quebec. Jacques loved sleeping outside even though he had a home and was a cabinetmaker in his spare time.  He might have a scar on his leg or foot.

Case reference: 2014002350.CaseDesc: On May 29th, 1990, Pierre Beaudoin left his residence in Hebron, Prince Edward Island. Police later confirmed that Pierre stayed at the Hotel Francis in New Richmond, Quebec and was seen for the last time on May 31, 1990, when he checked out of the hotel. Pierre’s truck and personal belongings were found in a dense, wooded area approximately 72 kilometers southeast of Route 275 in Balmoral, New Brunswick on August 17th, 1990.

Case reference: 2012020662.CaseDesc: Marc April was last seen at approximately 6:30 p.m. on January 31, 1987, at the Saskatoon City Hospital, Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. Marc was a patient at a hospital at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2022043376.CaseDesc: On August 17, 2022, Angela Alexis was seen for the last time by a family member as she was leaving a residence on the Alexis Nakota Sioux Nation in Alberta. A few days prior to her disappearance, Angela spent a few days socializing with family and friends.
